\usepackage{amsmath}
\usepackage{hyperref}
\begin{document}
\begin{equation}\label{eq:regression}
\begin{split}\begin{aligned}
R_k(t) = \exp\Bigg\{&
-\sum_{i=1}^{k-1}
\left[
\lambda_i T_i
+\left(\frac{T_{C_i}}{\alpha_i}\right)^{\beta_i}
-\left(\frac{T_{C_{i-1}}}{\alpha_i}\right)^{\beta_i}
\right]\\
&-\lambda_k t
-\left(\frac{T_{C_{k-1}}+t}{\alpha_k}\right)^{\beta_k}
+\left(\frac{T_{C_{k-1}}}{\alpha_k}\right)^{\beta_k}
\Bigg\}
\end{aligned}\end{split}
\end{equation}
\end{document}
